01 / ABOUT

About.

Someone who thinks seriously
and lives seriously too.

22 · Male · Notes of 2026

Hi, I'm Gofish. I'm currently pursuing a master's in mathematics at Southern University of Science and Technology, after studying Mathematical Foundation Science at Dalian University of Technology. Mathematics is where I begin to understand problems, and AI keeps bringing me new ones.

What fascinates me most is how agents improve themselves through experience, and how intelligence can truly enter the physical world through perception and action. I hope to find my own research direction between solid mathematical thinking and concrete experiments.

Off screen, I love traveling, badminton, cooking, and movies. To me, studying a problem seriously and cooking a meal seriously are both worth the effort.

02 / RESEARCH INTERESTS

What I'm curious about.

01

To lick, or not to lick?

KFC Original Recipe · Reinforcement learning

When is the best moment to lick your fingers? I want to model grease buildup, cooling chicken and the reward of a lick, then compare licking after every bite, waiting until the end and adaptive policies. An advertising slogan becomes a sequential decision problem.

Reinforcement learningReward designDynamic programming

Possible approach

Represent the state with grease, remaining chicken and temperature; choose to eat, lick or wipe. Solve a small model with dynamic programming, then see whether Q-learning approaches its optimal policy.

How I would evaluate it

Compare reward, time and accumulated discomfort under the same conditions, then vary preferences. Reward only grease actually removed, so endless licking cannot become a shortcut to a high score.

02

Is the middle bun a redundant token?

McDonald’s Big Mac · LLMs & structured ablation

Is a Big Mac still a Big Mac with one less bun? Borrowing from context compression and ablation studies, I want to separate the middle bun’s contribution by quantity from its role in the stack, and test whether LLMs can predict the changes in taste and stability.

Context compressionAblation studiesMultimodal evaluation

Possible approach

Compare the original, middle-bun removal, an equal bread reduction from the outer buns and reordered layers. Ask an LLM to predict performance from ingredient descriptions and cross-section images before tasting.

How I would evaluate it

Rate flavor similarity, Big Mac identity, structural stability and personal preference separately, then compare them with model predictions. Tasting better and resembling the original are separate objectives.

Accuracy is one part of improvement. Cost, reliability and failure modes belong in the comparison too.
